items.body: Use the queued tender-feed capture if committed. Confirm the actual release timestamps and tender-stage coverage before ranking leads. An active feed entry alone does not establish a live response window or separately quotable work. Otherwise preserve the bounded result and the first-party evidence that would reopen it. Read back any saved result and include a lesson if closing an owned mission under a valid lease.
